messages:
maya: Heads-up everyone — I'm pausing the release train immediately. We're seeing a failure in the artifact signing service (signing-daemon) that causes verified artifact checks to fail during canary promo. Hold window unknown until we get a successful signing pass. Please stop new train submissions for now. :warning:

deploy-bot: [automated] artifact-check: 27/120 artifacts failed signature verification in the last 15m. Affected regions: global. See https://infra.internal/signing/status

owen: Confirming — signatures are returning `INVALID_SIGNATURE` from the signing proxy. Builds look fine locally. Is there a retry/backoff we can trigger?

ops-oncall: We're throttling signing requests while we investigate a credential expiry on a backend HSM. Engineers are on it; attempting a rolling credential refresh. This affects gating checks that require signed manifests. Dedicated pools and runtime infra are not impacted once artifacts are deployed.

sylvie: Exception flow for emergency customer rollouts? We have a P0 customer rollback ready but it needs the signed artifact to pass validation.

maya: Exceptions allowed only if you can provide a signed artifact via our out-of-band signing flow (manual HSM sign + ops verification). File a release-exception issue on the release-train board, label `oob-sign`, include artifact SHA and customer impact, and tag @release-coordinator + @ops-oncall. We'll attempt to sign within 60m for P0s.

release-coordinator: Temporary rollout rule added: until the signing service is restored, the train will not promote artifacts that fail signature checks. If >5% of promotions fail for signature errors over a 10m window, the train auto-pauses. This prevents unsigned or tampered artifacts from entering production.
